title: 第23章 门徒第24章 中州圣地圣女画心
lines: 当我再次打开珍宝阁的大门时，门口那一身白袍的无念显然一愣。
珍宝阁里面居然走出来一位年轻人！
看着门外的无念，我也一愣，旋即故装镇定的问道。
“阁下是谁！
来我珍宝阁门前所为何事？”
听到的的发问，无念赶紧施了一礼。
“弟子是珍宝阁主示意留在这里的，承蒙阁主赐惠九品神果，经过昨夜的时间，弟子已经吸收，不知道友是何人？”
无念的发问正合我意。
我清了清嗓子，然后郑重的说道。
“我乃珍宝阁第一大弟子！
阁主再次神游大地，现在珍宝阁由我负责！
我叫白枫！”
无念听到我这样说以后，没有任何怀疑，赶忙抬手。
“原来是白枫师兄，幸会。”
我点了点头。
“你就是师尊提起的获得翠果的人啊？听说你自废修为，现在怎么样了？”
我很好奇这无念不是成废人了，怎么现在看来没事似的。
无念难掩脸上的激动情绪。
“本以为九品神果的力量我会承受不住，但是没想到，却是十分温和，而且仅仅用了一夜，我就差不多完全吸收，修为不仅全部恢复，而且更进一步！”
停顿了一会后，无念眼神中闪缩着光芒。
“更为重要的是，这枚翠果改变了我天赋！”
无念的话中透露着很多消息！
而我更为奇怪的是一夜？
“你是说在阁主离开时，就过了那一个晚上？”
我问道。
无念点了点头。
“是啊，就过了一夜，天刚亮的时候我就吸收了差不多了，然后一直在外面等着。”
我的脑子轰的一声。
这两边的时间流逝是不同的！
心中顿时冒出来这样的想法！
之前自己就疑惑过，自己来这个边，第一次回去的时候，周黎来找自己，当时好像也是仅仅过了一夜！
我把这个猜测保留在心里，等离开的的时候验证一下就好了。
看到我沉默不语，无念也并未打扰。
珍宝阁前有很多宗门的暗探，想必珍宝阁主游历，而出来个年轻人的消息很快就会传出去的。
“走吧，无念师兄，既然这样，你也可以离开了。”
我冲着无念说道。
无念一愣，然后却突然跪倒在地。
“白枫师兄，希望您跟阁主请示一下，能不能收我为徒。”
看到我皱起眉头，无念急忙说道。
content_en:
When I opened the door of Zhenbao Pavilion again, Wu Nian, who was dressed in white robe at the door, was obviously taken aback.
A young man actually walked out of Zhenbao Pavilion!
Looking at Wu Nian outside the door, I was stunned, and then asked calmly.
"Who is your Excellency!
Why did you come to the door of my treasure pavilion? "
After hearing the question, Wu Nian quickly bowed.
"The disciple was asked to stay here by the master of the Treasure Pavilion. Thanks to the master of the pavilion, he gave me the ninth-grade divine fruit. After last night, the disciple has absorbed it. I wonder who my friend is?"
Wu Nian's question was exactly what I wanted.
I cleared my throat and said solemnly.
"I am the greatest disciple of Zhenbao Pavilion!
The Pavilion Master wanders around the earth again, and now I am in charge of the Treasure Pavilion!
My name is Bai Feng! "
After Wu Nian heard what I said, he quickly raised his hand without any doubt.
"It turns out to be Senior Brother Bai Feng. Nice to meet you."
I nodded.
"Are you the one who got the green fruit mentioned by Master? I heard that you gave up your cultivation. How are you doing now?"
I'm very curious about why Wu Nian seems to be fine now if he is not a disabled person.
Wu Nian could not hide the excitement on his face.
"I thought I wouldn't be able to bear the power of the ninth-grade divine fruit, but I didn't expect it to be very gentle. And after just one night, I almost completely absorbed it. Not only did my cultivation level fully recover, but it also went further!"
After a pause, Wu Nian's eyes flashed.
"More importantly, this green fruit has changed my talent!"
Wu Nian’s words revealed a lot of news!
What is even more strange to me is one night?
"You mean that night passed when the Pavilion Master left?"
I asked.
Wu Nian nodded.
"Yeah, it just took one night. I absorbed it almost as soon as it dawned, and then I kept waiting outside."
There was a bang in my head.
The passage of time is different on these two sides!
This thought suddenly came to my mind!
I had doubts before. When I came here for the first time, Zhou Li came to see me. It seemed that he only spent one night!
I'll keep this guess in my mind, and I'll just verify it when I leave.
Seeing my silence, Wu Nian didn't bother me.
There are many spies from the sect in front of the Zhenbao Pavilion. It must be that the master of the Zhenbao Pavilion is traveling and the news about the young man coming out will spread soon.
"Let's go, senior brother Wu Nian. In this case, you can leave."
I said to Wu Nian.
Wu Nian was stunned for a moment, and then suddenly fell to his knees.
"Senior Brother Bai Feng, I hope you can ask the Pavilion Master if you can accept me as your disciple."
Seeing me frowning, Wu Nian said hurriedly.
